method.decision: Use the current production worker's three exact views and reviewed CPU model, with its existing native mean and point. Compare matched gains and losses without fitting. These are whole-image responses for fully generated and ordinary scenes, without localized edit or real-world error claims.
method.sources: Use all 34 native original files of the earlier held JPEG panel, not chosen by their scores. Retain the native and JPEG75 readings as earlier matched measurements.
method.transform: Encode the native upright RGB pixels at Pillow JPEG qualities 35 and 15. No resize, crop, orientation change, metadata, optimization or progressive coding. Use standard 4:2:0 sampling.
